prose: Luke Renda invited me to speak on Feel The Link podcast. This was a great conversation about all my favorite things.

From the show: In this episode I had the pleasure of interviewing Chance Garton of InnerVerse Podcast. I have a feeling that our discussion about syncretism and Astro-Theology will be very valuable going forward with my upcoming presentations. I was very glad to have Chance with his wealth of knowledge and open mind to bounce ideas off on the subject. Chance talks of his work with sound healing using tuning forks to aid in the healing of the human bio field. I had a great time talking with Chance and really appreciate him sharing his time with me. Hope you all enjoy.
